description: Source code for the MAX_Admin_Invocation class, which handles generating invocation codes, forms, and tracker scripts for ad banners within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: MAX_Admin_Invocation
classes.description: A class for generating invocation codes, forms, and tracker scripts for ad banners in Revive Adserver.

methods.name: getAllowedVariables
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed invocation variables.

methods.name: assignVariables
methods.description: Assigns invocation variables to the object, either from globals or passed parameters.

methods.name: generateInvocationCode
methods.description: Generates the banner invocation code based on the current variables and plugin.

methods.name: generateWebsiteInvocationCode
methods.description: Generates website-specific invocation code, ensuring the plugin implements the required interface.

methods.name: generateTrackerCode
methods.description: Creates a tracker code snippet for a given tracker ID.

methods.name: _generateTrackerImageBeacon
methods.description: Generates a hidden image beacon for tracking purposes.

methods.name: placeInvocationForm
methods.description: Creates an HTML form for selecting and configuring invocation options.

methods.name: getTextAreaAndOptions

methods.name: getDefaultOptionsList
methods.description: Provides a list of default options for invocation.
